what_it_measures: the SHARED autoencoder's own ceiling: encode the TRUE picture, decode it, judge it.  No arm is involved.
protocol: 2,000 admissible requests, 12 layouts, latent D = 128, batch 64

rows.loss_on_object_and_colour_channels: spatial softmax over the 225 cells for the four objects; colour still BCE
spatial softmax for the four objects + MASKED per-cell softmax over the 5 colours wherever a colour lives
rows.note: still improving at 1,500 steps -- the VAL smoke trains the shared autoencoder for 6,000 steps and reports the realised ceiling on every row

decision: the judge takes an argmax over 225 cells and an argmax over 5 colours, so every piece of the loss is the cross-entropy of exactly that argmax.  A per-cell BCE never makes the correct cell compete against the other 224.
